metadata.description: All Yukon snow monitoring stations: manual snow courses (YSS, periodic Feb/Mar/Apr/May surveys), automated snow-weather stations with snow-pillow SWE (YSS), and ECCC climate stations with daily snow depth mirrored into AquaCache (YKEC). Only stations with a continuous series appear in all_snow_stations.geojson.

properties.name: Otter Falls
properties.operator: Environment and Climate Change Canada

data_variables.name: air_temp_degc
data_variables.description: Air temperature.
data_variables.notes: Instantaneous series, or the ECCC daily '(min+max)/2' mean. Native units: °C. AquaCache timeseries 1670, aggregation '(min+max)/2', recording rate '1 day'.

data_variables.name: air_temp_min_degc
data_variables.description: Daily minimum air temperature.
data_variables.notes: ECCC daily series only. Native units: °C. AquaCache timeseries 1671, aggregation 'minimum', recording rate '1 day'.

data_variables.name: air_temp_max_degc
data_variables.description: Daily maximum air temperature.
data_variables.notes: ECCC daily series only. Native units: °C. AquaCache timeseries 1672, aggregation 'maximum', recording rate '1 day'.

data_variables.name: snwd_cm
data_variables.description: Snow depth from an automated sensor (Yukon and ECCC stations) or from a 10-point manual snow course survey. Native API unit is cm.
data_variables.notes: Native units: cm. NB: /snow-survey/data leaves the units field empty for this parameter; cm is confirmed by the /snow-survey/stats field name 'max_DEPTH_cm'. AquaCache timeseries 1673, aggregation 'instantaneous', recording rate '1 day'.

data_variables.name: precip_total_mm
data_variables.description: Total precipitation accumulated over the recording interval.
data_variables.notes: Aggregation type 'sum'. Returned in native mm without conversion, as in the DataBC client. AquaCache timeseries 1674, aggregation 'sum', recording rate '1 day'.

data_variables.name: precip_rain_mm
data_variables.description: Rainfall accumulated over the recording interval.
data_variables.notes: Aggregation type 'sum'. Native units: mm. AquaCache timeseries 1675, aggregation 'sum', recording rate '1 day'.

data_variables.name: precip_snow_cm
data_variables.description: New snowfall accumulated over the recording interval.
data_variables.notes: ECCC daily series. The /timeseries units field is empty for this parameter; cm comes from /parameters (id 1221). AquaCache timeseries 1676, aggregation 'sum', recording rate '1 day'.
